notes.title: Valentine's Day Update & 2 Year Anniversary Sale!
notes.notes:
Can you believe it's been two years since Max Gentlemen Sexy Business! launched? 
(Well, technically it launched on the 25th but I'm going to cheat a little, if you'll forgive me.)

To celebrate this, the last planned update, Max Gentlemen Sexy Business! is 69% off! That's the largest discount we're likely to ever have!

We've added two new costume sets. A Valentine's set and a buff set to match the beard set we added in November. To unlock the buff costumes, just raise any executive's fisticuffs over 100. ːarmpumpː

Oh, and in case you needed an excuse to spend more time with your favorite executives, we've added 25 new friendships for Angel and Cashious with the rest of the cast! They become available near the end of the 3rd arc. (And should be available right away if you've reached that point.)

So maybe you noticed that I called this the last planned update. What does that mean? Well, officially, Sexy Business is no longer my first priority. It's time I moved on to a new project. It's been an amazing four years since I started Sexy Business and I'm so happy to have been able to add the expansion and all these free updates. The community is really amazing and I'm sad to leave this project behind. Is this the end for Max Gentlemen? Probably not. I still have a few ideas for Sexy Business, but I have no idea when and if I will get to them. So for now, I hope what we made is good enough.

If you'd like to follow me, the developer, the best place to do that is twitter. @hatsproductions

If you'd like to squeeze as much blood out of the stone that is Max Gentlemen Sexy Business! I recommend dropping into the Discord to discuss the finer points of your favorite characters, outfits and dates. https://discord.gg/Baj5dp2

Cheers!

notes.title: Free Update Delay
notes.notes:
Hello everyone. It's now December and the "Fall" release window that I was aiming for for the Free The British are COMING! update is almost past us.

As you can imagine, the pandemic has impacted everyone on the team and our schedule was nothing more than wishful thinking during this bollocks of a year. Rest assured, this update is all I've been working on. We've even brought on 5 new team members since launch! On the plus side, the extra time means we've been able to add even more content than we originally planned. So where does the update stand? Well, I'm currently aiming for "Winter(?)" now.

I apologize for the delay and it's heartbreaking to have to wait so long to share our work with you. I must ask you to wait a bit longer but I can promise it will be worth it (free!?) We could easily charge $10 for the amount of content we're adding -or- have rushed it out the door to meet the initial deadline but... well, nah I'd rather do a good job and reward our fan-base with the luscious update you all deserve.

Speaking of, Here is a peek at just some of features to expect in the update:

 New asset upgrades system
 40+ new illustrations
 50+ new outfits
 70+ new genstona parts
 New business events
 A butt-load of unlockable "Friendships": vignettes between characters
 4 new lunch date activities
 A dozen more explicit Smutty Magazine unlocks (for the adult version) ːstachewinkː


As always you are welcome to hop on our Discord for more frequent updates and discussion https://discord.gg/BnhRpte

Cheers!

notes.title: Substantial Free Update Coming Fall 2020
notes.notes:
Dear Gentlepersons of culture and taste,

Allow me the pleasure of officially announcing the FREE update we've been handcrafting for your explicit satisfaction.

The British are COMING! update features

Two new datable Characters: Cashious Villionaire and Angel Fullbody.
An expanded 3rd run with new mechanics and an integrated storyline.
New lunch dates, buildings, upgrades, challenges and more!
Dozens of new outfits for characters new and old.
Tons of new Gentsona parts.


We're so excited to be able to make this new content for you. Our hope is to not only improve the base game but to create a reason for experienced fans to come back and romp through the world of Max Gentlemen Sexy Business! again.

And we love our fans so much that this update will be free! That's right. All you have to do is sit on your (no doubt excellent) buttocks and wait for the new content to roll into your lap. Keep an eye out for future updates and in the meantime I cordially invite you to join our Discord; the perfect place to continue the conversation with fellow lovers of all things Max Gentlemen. https://discord.gg/BnhRpte


Cheers!
